## Robust One Dark output for Quarto

`quarto_auto_dark_theme` is a reusable Quarto extension for static HTML
documents and RevealJS presentations. It combines Quarto's native theme switch,
One Dark CSS, `gt`/`gtsummary` table styling, and render-time companion images
for R plots.

## Examples

- [HTML document example](template.html)
- [RevealJS presentation example](examples/revealjs.html)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/thomashusson29/quarto_auto_dark_theme)

## Minimal Usage

```yaml
format:
  auto-dark-html:
    toc: true
```

```r
source("_extensions/thomashusson29/auto-dark/auto-dark-setup.R")
auto_dark_on()
```

## What Is Covered

| Output | Strategy |
|---|---|
| `ggplot2`, base R, CART, ROC, `forestplot` | Render-time `*-auto-dark.*` companion images |
| `flowchart` | Transparent canvas adapter plus companion images |
| `knitr::include_graphics()` | Local PNG/JPEG/WebP companion images |
| `gt` / `gtsummary` | Targeted One Dark CSS |
| RevealJS | Icon switch plus shared companion-image logic |

PDF output is intentionally unchanged.
